0022600143.text: The Clippers host the Lakers in their fourth game of the season, sitting at 1-2 and 10th in the West after two straight losses, while the Lakers are 3-0, first in the West and first in the Pacific, on a three-game winning streak. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are all out for the Clippers. The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles on October 23, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
